method.driver: EasyBIS sim-score d743103 _build/simtool. For each request replace base_ref by the object from bases under the base key and submit as driver INPUT.json. The newer driver's duplicate 13937 effect is skipped if already registered and excludes the 4696 drink on use; the tested gear uses neither weapon. The 4k Nature comparisons require the per-fight DPS vector (SaveAllValues, Dps.AllValues).
method.paired_trials: The same RNG seed is used for both complete gear sets. The first job is the incumbent with its actual item, not the empty slot. All doses are raw WoWSims rating points. The Nature ablation uses the deployed driver recording each iteration's DPS; pair by iteration, standard error is sample stdev of the differences divided by sqrt(n).
method.restrictions: The Hunter rotation mentions an inactive item 13213 in both versions; neither side of a duel changes a trinket. The sensitivity tests measure conditional raid DPS, not universal thresholds.
method.target: WoWSims single raid target 31146, 180 s +/- 5 s, target health 1428900 and block value 54, execute 35%/20% as in the audit driver.
